_about: Per-video settings for scripts/youtube-publish.py. Edit titles, tags and dates here; the description is built from video/DESCRIPTION.md, the blurb below and the track's credit in video/music/CREDITS.md. privacy: private | unlisted | public; publishAt (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-27T15:00:00-03:00) schedules a private video to go public then. YouTube counts a vertical video as a Short only up to 3:00.
